text:
Type: opal glass globe wall lamp
Use: soft light beside a mirror or along a hallway wall; bathroom, hallway, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic, retro
Materials: white opal glass globe, brushed nickel-plated metal arm and round wall plate
Colors: milky white, brushed silver
Shape: round glass ball resting in a cup holder at the end of a curved swan-neck arm, stepped circular backplate, compact and light
Feel: soft, gentle, nostalgic, tidy
Goes with: white tiles, chrome or nickel fittings, pale walls; classic or traditional bathrooms and hallways

product.name: LILLHOLMEN
product.description: Flexible; can be mounted with the light turned downwards or upwards.
